## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Record of the Perfected Chángchūn's Journey to the West*

by [李志常](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E5%BF%97%E5%B8%B8) (Lǐ Zhìcháng, 1193–1256)

**The travel-narrative of [丘處機](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%98%E8%99%95%E6%A9%9F) Qiū Chǔjī's 1219–1223 overland journey to meet Chinggis Khan** in the Hindu Kush, recorded by his disciple Lǐ Zhìcháng. **One of the major primary sources for 13th-century Central Asian history and Mongol-period religious-political relations.** Preserved as **DZ 1429** / CT 1429 (正一部).

**Dating.** 1228. Dynasty: 元.
